newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's IBGE revises down wheat crop slightly.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's IBGE revises down wheat crop slightly.

text.p: Brazil's 1996 wheat crop should reach 3.04 million tonnes, slightly down from a previous forecast of 3.09 million tonnes, said the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) in its monthly report.
This is still however up 98.09 percent on last year's crop of 1.53 million tonnes.
The downward revision is due to prolonged dry weather, particularly in Parana and Sao Paulo states.
The IBGE now sees planted area at 1.79 million hectares, up slightly from the 1.77 million hectares forecast last month.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
